title: First paid jobs: Kiddo's band, Silver Star and the St. Claude band
summary: Nelson's first job was with Kiddo's band at the Silver Star; later he worked with Herbert Moran and in a band on St. Claude with George Lewis, a woman pianist and drummer Richard Hall.
